scope: Append-only attributable custody event ledger recording actor, timestamp, and reason with cryptographic hash chaining and anti-rewrite invariants

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.
Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all 21 test suites in tests (including C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C10, and C11 custody ledger suites).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked repository JSON files and contract invariants.

observations: LedgerStore.AppendEvent in internal/custody/events.go strictly validates and records actor, timestamp, reason, and custody transfer endpoints into append-only .jsonl ledger files.
Missing actor, missing reason, missing timestamp, or unavailable provider produce distinct explicit validation errors (ErrMissingActor, ErrMissingReason, ErrMissingTimestamp, ErrUnavailableProvider).
Cryptographic hash chaining binds each event to the preceding event digest (PrevHash) and computes an incremental CustodyRoot via SHA-256.

No update or delete API exists on LedgerStore; modifying or rewriting historical events on disk causes VerifyChain and OpenLedgerStore to detect chain corruption and fail closed with ErrChainCorrupted/ErrHashMismatch.
Restart and recovery retains the complete custody history, monotonic sequence numbers, and valid CustodyRoot across closing and reopening the store.
Sealed evidence source bytes are verified to remain completely unmodified during and after custody operations.

observed_limitations: Verification of signed externally stored custody checkpoints belongs to C12 (internal/custody/checkpoints.go).
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/custody/events.go, tests/custody_test.go, and C11 fixtures/evidence. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
